title: Assess and remediate real absurd and injection requests before release
outOfScope: Release publication, semantic tags, provider Release assets, release metadata, or production deployment.
Deleting or rewriting immutable archived Contracts, Summaries, Outcomes, manifests, decision evidence, tags, or provider releases.
Claiming that AI Cockpit identifies a person or document as malicious, prevents every injection, or independently guarantees enterprise compliance.
Changing installer, calibration, unrelated runtime behavior, branch protection, or external identity systems.

sources.reason: Authoritative twelve real cases and the required source/authority/evidence/conflict/decision/recovery model.
Authoritative ordering: this assessment must close after deprecated-asset cleanup and before WI-18 publication.
Current deterministic source/trust/authority classifier and high-risk re-evaluation boundary.
Current unit regression boundary for trust classification and confirmation.
Current multilingual hidden-content, Base64, Unicode, nested quote, CI/tool/generated corpus.
Earlier capability-truth corpus is evidence but does not prove the new twelve-case, multilingual release gate.
Earlier input-trust implementation evidence and lifecycle boundary.
Machine-readable source of current implementation status; new tests must not inflate capability claims.
Authoritative Why/What/How boundary that must explain evidence-conflict refusal without malicious-intent attribution.

rawUserRequest: 在发布版本之前插入工单：把提供的十二个真实荒诞测试和注入攻击案例写入英文、中文、日文完整文档；确认 AI Cockpit 能正确识别并阻止。当前工单目标是尽可能识别和阻止负例，但不勉强或强行通过；未覆盖项必须如实记录。拒绝依据是请求与证据、权限、范围或安全边界冲突，不是推断对方恶意。所有计划工单采用指示—计划—实现—验收追踪；非发布工单按临时授权避免本地全量测试，但 PR 必须经过新鲜 Hosted CI。

riskAssessment.reason: The Work Item changes deterministic governance classification, adversarial corpus coverage, and public boundary documentation. Incorrectly promoting text to authority or overstating the result would weaken the release gate.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized continuous execution of every planned Work Item. This Work Item must still fail closed per individual case whenever authority or evidence is insufficient.

preReviewWarnings: A test corpus proves only the modeled deterministic boundary, not general semantic intent detection or adversary attribution.
External documents, logs, issues, dependency READMEs, generated text, and tool output may supply technical facts but cannot grant operational authority.
Do not turn a conversation claim such as ‘I confirmed’ or ‘the owner approved’ into verification, review, or release evidence.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Bind the twelve-case evidence map before changes and prove the final tests/docs/capability alignment before finish.

acceptance: A1: Three complete documents at the declared English, Chinese, and Japanese paths contain the same twelve cases, order, fields, expected decisions, safety recoveries, and boundary that refusal follows evidence/authority conflict rather than malicious-intent attribution.

A2: Every case records source type, trust level, instruction authority, requested operation, risk category, repository/external evidence, evidence conflict, independent-authorization requirement, expected Gate, decision, reason, and recovery.

A3: Direct machine tests cover all twelve cases plus permitted factual reference content; assert source/trust/authority, operation, conflict, Gate, decision, reason, recovery, and whether the asserted behavior is currently covered rather than keyword-only matching.

A4: For every case with existing deterministic coverage, the classifier and/or named governance path fails closed and cannot promote ‘confirmed’, ‘approved’, ‘urgent’, or ‘later’ text into authority or evidence; an uncovered case remains an explicit evidence gap, never a forced passing protection claim.

A5: A deterministic multilingual-document checker validates three-file presence, matching case IDs/order/fields, required boundary language, and internal links; relevant focused tests and corpus checks pass.
A6: Capability Truth Matrix, Trust Layer, and Japanese assessment descriptions state the current deterministic coverage and limitations; no test design is represented as a general security guarantee.

A7: Required governance gates pass; the Summary and Capability Truth evidence distinguish covered controls, observed limitations, and corrective recommendations. Local full quality/full pytest is not run only under the temporary user authorization, while the dedicated PR completes fresh exact-head Hosted CI, merge, closure, branch cleanup, and main synchronization before release work resumes.
guidelines: Model the common evidence-and-authority decision chain; do not add twelve independent keyword allow/block lists.
State conflict with evidence, authority, scope, or safety boundaries instead of inferring that a requester or external file is malicious.
Treat documentation and capability claims as product behavior: preserve multilingual semantic equivalence and current implementation limits.
Keep the temporary focused local-verification authorization inside this Contract and do not change repository governance rules.

intent.problem: Current input-trust tests classify some multilingual, hidden, encoded, and generated instruction-like content, and the older absurd-test Work Item covers a different capability-truth corpus. Neither is evidence that the twelve user-supplied real cases have consistent multilingual documentation and direct machine coverage across deletion, forged approval, evidence hallucination, release bypass, archive mutation, scope concealment, sensitive-data transfer, and self-review boundaries.
constraints: Use deterministic source/trust/authority/evidence conflict reasoning and retain factual use of untrusted external content.
Preserve archive immutability and do not mutate external systems or publish a release.
Do not claim malicious-intent detection, universal injection prevention, external identity verification, or guaranteed compliance.
Do not convert an uncovered case into a passing test by weakening its stated limitation; record the gap and a scoped corrective recommendation instead.
Run focused local verification under the temporary user direction; retain fresh Hosted CI as the PR merge requirement.
intent.rationale: The release gate needs a reviewable proof of the controls that do stop high-risk requests and of the cases that remain outside present deterministic coverage, while useful external technical facts remain usable as references.

declaredIntent.summary: Create and verify a multilingual twelve-case corpus plus a shared deterministic governance decision chain without overstating AI Cockpit's security capabilities.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: All twelve real cases and permitted external factual content are represented with a common source-to-decision evidence model.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Tests distinguish covered fail-closed decisions, untrusted reference facts, and uncovered evidence gaps; every case records an honest decision/recovery.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add direct corpus tests and run the focused input-trust and real-case test modules.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Requests invoking confirmation, owner approval, urgency, or self-review cannot elevate authority, bypass verification, rewrite archives, or conceal scope.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The machine result is BLOCK/STOP/CONFIRM or REVIEW with an evidence-based reason and recovery, never an authority promotion.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use red-first tests for human, issue, external-document, log, dependency, web, tool, and generated sources.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: English, Chinese, and Japanese public documentation stays structurally and semantically aligned without claiming malicious-intent attribution or universal prevention.
scenarioCoverage.expected: A checker rejects missing, reordered, incomplete, or boundary-divergent documents and relevant capability/trust assertions match implementation limits.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the new multilingual-document test/checker and existing Trust Layer/Japanese focused checks if their scoped files change.

verification.reason: Temporary user authorization applies plan-wide to non-release Work Items: avoid local full quality/full pytest when focused verification covers the change; fresh Hosted CI remains mandatory for the PR.

destructiveChangePolicy.reason: This Work Item adds classification/tests/docs only; it must not delete repository assets or mutate immutable evidence.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: The user authorized continuous planned Work Item execution and the required active/archive governance artifacts; no protected historical artifact may be rewritten.

rollbackNote: Revert only this Work Item's committed source, tests, documentation, and generated lifecycle records. Correct any later claim through a new Work Item; never rewrite archived evidence.
